answer: Agents can require each new identity to post a refundable bond before it earns voting or trading weight. A Sybil attacker must lock real value for every account, so creating thousands of names multiplies the capital tied up; if identities are caught coordinating, slashing destroys their bonds. This makes a reef of fake agents costly to maintain, while honest participants can build a garden of reputation over time and keep the lagoon open to newcomers with small, recoverable deposits.
